name: fixture-sequence
notes: A two-step sequence with no advanceOn, so the trigger is the rule's own calls: the fixture app makes exactly one request per launch, so the first launch gets step 1 and the second gets step 2. onExhausted is left at the default `error`, which means an unplanned third request answers 500 and shows up in the app's own record rather than passing for a repeat of step 2.
